translation.title: Diclofenac Sodium Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for osteoarthritis, periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, elbow pain (tennis elbow, etc.), muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Apply 1 cataplasm (pap) to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have or have had hypersensitivity to it or to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you have or have had asthma caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you are a child under 18, a pregnant woman past the fifth month of pregnancy, breastfeeding, or a patient with peptic ulcer. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, elderly, if you have or have had hypersensitivity to propylene glycol, or if you are hypersensitive to sodium pyrosulfite. Do not use continuously for more than 2 weeks. Do not apply to skin with lesions (exudative dermatitis, eczema, infected lesions, burns, wounds, etc.), or to the eyes or mucous membranes. Do not use an occlusive dressing without a doctor's supervision. Do not use together with other diclofenac products or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are using loop diuretics (furosemide, etc.), thiazide diuretics, drugs that interfere with blood clotting (warfarin, etc.), antiplatelet agents (aspirin, etc.), selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors. Photosensitivity reactions, swelling, skin peeling, eczema, dry skin, sometimes dermatitis, itching, redness, roughness, or irritation, rarely blistering, pigmentation, or anaphylactic symptoms (hypersensitivity reactions, hives, angioedema, difficulty breathing, etc.) may occur. If skin symptoms such as redness, red spots, rash, itching, or pain appear at the application site and worsen into contact dermatitis with swelling, blisters, or erosion, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist; it may spread over the whole body and become severe. If any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
